# TASK: Full code review and bug-fix loop for the kids store

Read first, if they exist: CLAUDE.md, PROJECT_SPEC.md, TASKS.md, IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md. Follow CLAUDE.md. Fix bugs only: do not add features, redesign, or refactor beyond what a fix requires.

Stack: Next.js 16.4 (App Router, Turbopack), React, TypeScript strict, Tailwind (logical utilities, RTL), Prisma 6.19, PostgreSQL, zod, Vitest, Playwright. Locales fr and ar. Windows dev machine (stop `npm run dev` before `prisma generate`). Known Next 16 rule: routes that await `params` or `searchParams` must do it inside a <Suspense> boundary or export `instant = false`.

## Setup
1. Check `git status`. If there are uncommitted changes, stop and tell me. Otherwise create the branch `review/bugfix-loop`.
2. Establish the BASELINE and record it: run `npx prisma validate`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm test`, Playwright (if configured), `npm audit --omit=dev`. Note which fail before any change, so you never take credit or blame for pre-existing state.

## The loop (max 5 rounds)
Each round has four steps.

### Step A: REVIEW (independent, read-only)
Use sub-agents so reviewers do not share the fixer's assumptions: spawn separate review agents in parallel (Explore / general-purpose / a code-review agent if available), one per area below. Also run the built-in review commands or skills if available (for example /review and /security-review, and any code-review, security or testing skills you have). Reviewers must not edit files. Areas:
1. Auth and sessions: password hashing, session tokens, cookies, expiry, logout, lockout/rate limiting, first-admin creation.
2. Authorization: every admin page, server action and route handler enforces a server-side permission check; no IDOR; roles and permissions matrix correct.
3. Input validation and injection: zod on every input, SQL/ORM misuse, XSS (product descriptions in TEXT/HTML/MARKDOWN must be sanitized on save and render), CSRF on mutations, open redirects, SSRF, file upload type/size/path handling, CSV/formula injection in exports.
4. Data and Prisma: schema vs. code mismatches, missing indexes/unique constraints, relation and cascade errors (ProductVariant, ProductImage, Inventory, CartItem, OrderItem), money as floats, race conditions in stock and order creation, missing transactions, migrations drift.
5. Storefront correctness: pages read from the database (not lib/store-catalog.ts), caching and revalidation after admin changes, draft/archived products hidden, 404 handling, search, listings, product and category pages.
6. Cart, checkout and orders: totals, discounts and shipping computed server-side only, idempotent order creation, stock checks, order status transitions.
7. Next 16 and React: Suspense rule on dynamic routes, server vs client component misuse, hydration issues, `use client` boundaries, env vars leaking to the client, error and not-found boundaries, loading states.
8. i18n, RTL and accessibility: fr/ar completeness, hard-coded left/right classes instead of logical utilities, missing `lang`/`dir`, labels, alt text, keyboard and focus, color contrast.
9. Config and quality: env handling and .env.example, secrets in code or git history, dead code, unhandled promise rejections, swallowed errors, stack traces shown to users, lint/TS suppressions (`any`, `@ts-ignore`, eslint-disable) hiding real problems.

Every finding must be a record: id, severity (critical/high/medium/low), file:line, evidence (code quote, error, or reproduction), expected vs actual, proposed fix. A finding without evidence is discarded. Then DEDUPLICATE and VERIFY: confirm each finding yourself by reading the code or reproducing it; mark it CONFIRMED, PLAUSIBLE (cannot reproduce) or REJECTED. Do not fix PLAUSIBLE ones without telling me.

### Step B: FIX
Fix CONFIRMED findings, highest severity first. For each fix:
- Add or update a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after (Vitest for logic, Playwright for flows). If a test is impractical, say why.
- Make the smallest change that removes the root cause. No lint or TypeScript suppressions, no weakened or deleted tests, no catch-and-ignore.
- If a fix needs a product decision (behavior change, schema or destructive migration, new dependency), do NOT guess: list it under "needs owner decision" and continue with the rest.
- Database changes only through Prisma migrations; ask me before any destructive migration.

### Step C: VERIFY
Re-run the full gate: `npx prisma validate`, lint, typecheck, `npm run build`, `npm test`, Playwright, `npm audit --omit=dev`. Compare against the baseline. A fix that breaks something else is a failed fix: revert or repair it in this round.

### Step D: COMMIT AND LOG
One commit per round on the review branch (clear message listing finding ids), and append a short round summary to IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md: findings found/fixed/rejected/deferred, tests added, gate results. Do not create extra report files.

## Stopping rule (be honest about it)
Stop when ALL are true: (1) the full gate is green except items that were already failing in the baseline for reasons outside the code (list them); (2) TWO consecutive independent review rounds with fresh reviewer agents produce zero new CONFIRMED findings; (3) no CONFIRMED finding remains open except "needs owner decision". Also stop after round 5 even if not done, and report what remains. Never claim "no bugs" or "secure" or "production-ready": say instead "no confirmed findings in rounds N and N+1 under these checks", and list what was NOT covered (for example real payment flows, load testing, penetration testing, real devices, Arabic copy quality).

## Final report (in the chat)
1. Rounds run and stop reason. 2. Table of fixed findings (id, severity, file, one line). 3. Open items and "needs owner decision". 4. Gate results now vs. baseline. 5. Coverage gaps and recommended next steps (for example a manual security review before launch). Do not merge or push; I will review the branch.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Category {
  id          String       @id @default(uuid())
  slug        String       @unique
  nameFr      String
  nameAr      String
  description String?
  image       String?
  createdAt   DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime     @updatedAt
  products    Product[]
}

model Product {
  id           String          @id @default(uuid())
  slug         String          @unique
  titleFr      String
  titleAr      String
  descriptionFr String
  descriptionAr String
  price        Decimal         @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  oldPrice     Decimal?        @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  costPrice    Decimal?        @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  isActive     Boolean         @default(true)
  isFeatured   Boolean         @default(false)
  isDraft      Boolean         @default(false)
  badge        String?
  ageRangeFr   String?
  ageRangeAr   String?
  categoryId   String
  category     Category        @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variants     ProductVariant[]
  images       ProductImage[]
  inventory    Inventory?
  createdAt    DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime        @updatedAt
  orderItems   OrderItem[]
}

model ProductVariant {
  id         String      @id @default(uuid())
  productId  String
  product    Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  nameFr     String
  nameAr     String
  sku        String      @unique
  price      Decimal?    @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  stock      Int         @default(0)
  createdAt  DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime    @updatedAt
  cartItems  CartItem[]
  orderItems OrderItem[]
}

model ProductImage {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  productId String
  product   Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  url       String
  position  Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  alt       String
}

model Inventory {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  productId   String   @unique
  product     Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  stock       Int      @default(0)
  lowStockAlert Int    @default(5)
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Cart {
  id        String     @id @default(uuid())
  sessionId String     @unique
  items     CartItem[]
  createdAt DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime   @updatedAt
}

model CartItem {
  id        String         @id @default(uuid())
  cartId    String
  cart      Cart           @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variantId String
  variant   ProductVariant @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  quantity  Int            @default(1)
  createdAt DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime       @updatedAt
  @@unique([cartId, variantId])
}

model User {
  id            String       @id @default(uuid())
  email         String       @unique
  passwordHash  String
  fullName      String
  phone         String?
  role          UserRole     @default(CUSTOMER)
  sessions      Session[]
  orders        Order[]      @relation("CustomerOrders")
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt
}

model Session {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId       String
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token        String   @unique
  expiresAt    DateTime
